name: hc-telegram-no-recipient
prompt: Bug: the 'Add Telegram' page reads the recipient (chat) data from the querystring. A GET renders the form; a POST creates the integration. A POST with no recipient data in the querystring still creates a Telegram integration, whose stored value is the string "null" — which breaks every piece of code that expects the integration's value to be a serialized JSON object. Expected: such a POST is rejected with HTTP 400 and creates nothing.
